description: NaCaAlH₂OF₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.69 Å. Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to two equivalent O and six F atoms. There is one shorter (2.50 Å) and one longer (2.55 Å) Ca-O bond length. There are a spread of Ca-F bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.50 Å. Al is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.81-1.88 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. O is bonded in a water-like geometry to two equivalent Ca and two H atoms. There are six inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one Al atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one Al atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one Al atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ca and one Al atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one Al atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one Al atom.
